_comment: Codex-side registration of the same two hooks as .claude/settings.json. The scripts are byte-identical copies; keep them that way (SETUP.md names the byte-compare as a verification step). The path resolves from the working directory on purpose: each person mounts the Shared Drive under their own account, so an absolute path must never land in this shared file. NOTE: repo-local hook support varies by Codex version and this file may be inert in yours. Session logging does not depend on it: the session-marker rule in AGENTS.md covers every surface, hooks or not. See SETUP.md.
